decision.observation: The attempted Strike did not resolve: both Strikes remain, energy is still 2/3, and the rightmost Acid Slime remains at 9/9 HP. Weakened and 2 Strength are visible beneath the player.
decision.hypothesis: Dragging from the settled left Strike's center should deal 6 damage to the 9-HP Slime; a second Strike can then defeat it.
decision.memory: Card drags can fail when the hand shifts. Weakened makes an 8-damage Strength-boosted Strike deal an expected 6 damage.
